page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m8.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate modest performance capabilities across compute and memory subsystems. The single-core and multi-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the weak to poor categories, with a Geekbench single-core score of 915.0 and a multi-core score of 1993.0. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with uncached large-block read speeds at 19.83 GB/sec and write speeds at 18.72 GB/sec. Database operations and static web serving throughput are similarly constrained, with web serving reaching 2.25 GB/sec and Redis SET operations executing at 2.92 million operations per second.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio paired with lower-tier compute benchmarks, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive applications that do not require high CPU throughput. It is suitable for lightweight database caching, memory-mapped file processing, or running small-scale applications that require a larger memory footprint without demanding intensive processing power.
